description: Per-study display embedding of the 139,701 endocrine cells with published labels of the 15 studies: study, context (the primary intestine is named "Native intestine"), sample, published label, mapped class, UMAP coordinates and log-normalized TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1, CHGA, FEV, LMX1A, INS, GCG, SST
upstream: Per study, from the labeled endocrine cells' raw counts: Seurat vst 2000 variable genes, log-normalization, scaling, 20 principal components, Harmony across samples (theta 2, lambda 1, sigma 0.1), then UMAP (uwot, cosine, 30 neighbors, min_dist 0.3, 500 epochs, seed 42); display only.

description: Raw and SoupX-corrected counts of TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1 (and INS, GCG, SST, CHGA) for every SC-islet cell with a published label
upstream: SoupX 1.6.2 per channel on the raw droplet matrices (soup from 1-100 UMI barcodes, clusters = published labels, autoEstCont then adjustCounts), keeping the corrected counts of these genes per labeled cell.

description: Raw and SoupX-corrected counts of TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1 and islet hormones for the intestinal EC and HIO graft EC cells, per capture, with whether the capture was corrected
upstream: SoupX 1.6.2 per capture on the raw droplet matrices of Elmentaite 2020 + 2021, Egozi 2021, Hickey 2023 (Dryad raw counts) and McCauley 2023 (soup from empty droplets, clusters = every labeled cell of the capture), keeping these genes for EC cells.

description: As gut_ec_soupx_serotonin_genes, for the primary intestine other EEC cells of the same captures
upstream: Same SoupX runs as gut_ec_soupx_serotonin_genes, keeping the primary intestine 'Other EEC' cells (Crohn's disease donors out).

description: Raw and SoupX-corrected counts of TPH1, DDC, SLC18A1 (and INS, GCG, SST, CHGA) for every adult islet endocrine cell with a published label, except the 208 cells of the one capture SoupX could not correct
upstream: SoupX 1.6.2 per capture on the raw droplet matrices of Fasolino 2022 and Bandesh 2026 (soup from 1-100 UMI barcodes, clusters = published labels of the labeled endocrine cells, autoEstCont then adjustCounts), keeping the corrected counts of these genes per labeled cell.
